caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with four horizontal drawers, each equipped with two ornate brass handles and one brass keyhole placed in the center. The chest is colored in various shades of brown, representing wood grain and giving depth to the surface. The chest has a rectangular top with a slightly beveled edge, vertical sides, and a plinth base supported by four short, carved legs featuring bracket feet. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details.
title: Chest of Drawers
